title: Systemic Risk Transmission to Energy Futures: Weekend Information Gaps and the Breakdown of Pricing Efficiency
source_revision: Conlon/Corbet/Larkin/Muniz, firstpublished2026-07-15, JFM46,1719–1747; primaryHTML selected sections
about: Weekday differences in connectedness between three COVOL indices and five energy markets.
findings: Authors find weaker Monday connectedness and state dependence; no net trading results reproduced or identified in inspected sections.
mechanism: Weekend information gaps are proposed; a changing covariance does not establish directional arbitrage.
build_on: No unconditional weekday trade or VIX-for-COVOL replacement. Need a separate justified causal forecast and exact panel before research returns.
code_feasibility: Connectedness analysis possible with matching data; a profitable signal is unspecified.
summary: Source-method check does not admit a directional strategy.
owned_input_map: Own CL prices cover one market. Source uses LSEG five-market daily prices plus three COVOL histories2011-01-01–2024-08-23; these are not own CL OHLCV or VIX.
reading_scope: Abstract,introduction,data/method and selected results/conclusions/data statement; full article/appendices not read.
